title: P5-M06 mail transport is an injected MailTransport contract: the product ships no SMTP client dependency
problem: P5-M06 (email-based password recovery, split out of P5-M03, upstream /rest/forgot-password over the P5 reset-token primitive) is blocked on exactly one thing: 'a mail-transport architecture decision (a dependency, or an injected transport contract); Node has no built-in SMTP'. The P5 reset-token primitive already covers token issue and verification; the open question is only how the recovery mail leaves the process. Bundling an SMTP client is a dependency decision; leaving the question open blocks the slice indefinitely. This decision answers the transport question so P5-M06 can be planned.

options.summary: Define MailTransport as an injected host contract in the repo's standard split (pure values in, frozen values out; the host does the IO). The product ships no SMTP client and no mail-provider SDK. P5-M06 sends recovery mail by calling the injected transport; tests use a recording fake transport; operators wire SMTP or provider-API adapters outside the product bundle.
Bundle a mature SMTP client dependency and own the SMTP conversation, TLS, auth and retry inside the product.
Bundle one mail provider's HTTP SDK and send mail through that provider's API.

rationale: Option A is the only choice consistent with how this repo is built. (1) Every contract in the codebase uses the same split: pure values in, frozen values out, the host does the IO; mail transport is host IO, so it belongs behind an injected contract. (2) The repo is deliberately dependency-averse: the catalog fetcher exists specifically to avoid a 70 MB dependency tree 'that a workflow runtime never executes', and an SMTP client would add TLS, auth and retry machinery the product would then own, patch and support. (3) Option C is the same IO problem with vendor lock-in on top. (4) An injected transport is the only variant that is fully testable in CI: a recording fake transport lets the recovery flow be tested deterministically with no network, no fixture mailbox and no credentials. (5) The operator keeps freedom to run SMTP, a provider API, or a corporate relay without a product release. (6) The blocker text itself enumerates the option space as 'a dependency, or an injected transport contract'; the owner's standing mandate instructs the Manager to remove removable blockers, and this is the option that removes the blocker without importing new supply-chain surface. Scope wall: this decision answers the transport question only. The recovery flow (endpoints, token timing, enumeration resistance, rate limiting) remains P5-M06's own delivery work and is NOT made complete, started or authorized for execution by this decision; it only moves from blocked to planned. REQ-0002 records the owner master prompt of 2026-09-27 that instructs the Manager to remove removable blockers and to give every kept blocker a concrete resolution path.
evidenceRefs: docs/n8n-lego/milestones.json (P5-M06 blockedBy text: the decision this resolves)
